source.code:
queue action drop-loot:
            with partial:
                @corpse: @who
            urgent: true

queue action start-corpse-run:
            with partial:
                @who: @who
            urgent: true
            abandon: @who.role != #PLAYER
        queue action gain-xp:
            with partial:
                @hero: @killer
                @victim: @who
            urgent: true
            abandon: @killer.role != #PLAYER

queue action level-up:
            with partial:
                @hero: @hero
            urgent: true
            abandon: @hero.xp < @hero.level * 50
        queue action quest-progress:
            with partial:
                @hero: @hero
                @victim: @victim
            urgent: true
            abandon: @hero.has_active_quest == false
        queue action share-xp:
            with partial:
                @hero: @hero
            urgent: true
            abandon: @hero.party == null

queue action quest-progress:
            with partial:
                @hero: @hero
                @victim: @victim
            urgent: true
            abandon: @hero.has_active_quest == false
        queue action share-xp:
            with partial:
                @hero: @hero
            urgent: true
            abandon: @hero.party == null

queue action share-xp:
            with partial:
                @hero: @hero
            urgent: true
            abandon: @hero.party == null

queue action respawn:
            with:
                @who: @who
            urgent: true
            abandon: @who.corpse_run_ticks_remaining > 0 || @who.alive == true

queue action level-up:
            with partial:
                @hero: @hero
            urgent: true
            abandon: @hero.xp < @hero.level * 50
